gloss: overlooking; missing; letting pass; catch-up viewing

definitions.explanation: failing to see or notice something, whether accidentally or intentionally
watching a TV program after its original broadcast, typically via streaming services

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked once more so as not to miss any important points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The referee's missed call changed the course of the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見逃|みのが}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Overlooking small mistakes leads to big problems.

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched yesterday's drama on catch-up streaming.

examples.english: The catch-up viewing service is convenient.

examples.english: That program is available free for one week on catch-up.

notes:
FORMS:
Noun form of ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ (to overlook, to let pass, to miss watching). Where English uses a verb, Japanese usually uses ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧: {見逃|みのが}してしまった, not {見逃|みのが}し⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
Overlooking (sense 1):
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (so as not to miss anything)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{厳禁|げんきん}→厳禁：18021_genkin⟧ (don't miss this, must-see)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧ (baseball: striking out looking)
Catch-up (sense 2):
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧ (catch-up streaming, e.g. on TVer or broadcaster apps)
- {見逃|みのが}し⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧ (catch-up viewing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見落|みお}とし→見落とし：14273_miotoshi⟧ (oversight): failing to notice through carelessness. {見逃|みのが}し also covers letting something pass on purpose, as when a referee lets a foul go.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦オンデマンド→オンデマンド：06597_ondemando⟧ (on-demand)
- ⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧ (recording)
